## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the duplicated adoption output before merge: the new `adopt` entries are rendered again by the command, so every adopted setting is reported twice.

## Changes
`plan` now returns an `adopt` entry for each setting that already exists and adds a trailing `audit` entry that counts the incoming settings. The pull request also adds two tests for the audit entry and a new text file, `app/review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop `run` from emitting adopt entries a second time — When `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` is called, "Adopted theme" is emitted twice. `plan` emits it as progress at app/planner.py:8, and app/cli.py:9 then emits the message of every change that is not `audit`, which now includes the new `adopt` entry. No test calls `run` with a setting that already exists. — Command users see every adopted setting reported twice, and no test would catch this regression. — Fix: Make app/cli.py:7 skip `adopt` entries as well as `audit` entries, then add a test in tests/test_planner.py that calls `run` with an existing setting.
